title: Public read-only data proxy controls
purpose: Define the minimum controls for a clean-room proxy that reads a specifically approved public source and returns bounded, non-sensitive data.
constraints: Reject arbitrary outbound URLs and all write operations.
Apply explicit origin policy rather than wildcard CORS for protected consumers.
Use a durable, appropriately scoped cache and rate-limit implementation; do not rely on process-local state for a distributed deployment.
Exclude secrets, raw provider payloads, customer data, and executable source from the catalogue asset.
